source_instruction: i looking a super soft fleece throw for  small pets size;40*30 inch
query:
I swear the squirrel that’s been hanging out on my apartment balcony the past two weeks has started recognizing me at this point. Every morning when I step out with my coffee, it’s perched on the rail holding a half-eaten acorn, tilting its head like it’s waiting for me to say hello before it scampers off to bury its snack in the potted mint I’ve been trying (and failing) to keep alive all summer. Yesterday I left a tiny handful of unsalted peanuts out for it, and it came back twice, once to grab a nut and once to sit there munching it like it was leaving a little thank you before it darted up the oak tree. It’s such a silly little routine, but it’s made dragging myself out of bed for early work meetings way more fun these past couple weeks.
Hey there, I’m looking around the throw blankets section for a sherpa throw that feels super soft, perfect for snuggling up with my little guy. I don’t want to spend too much, just something that’s a reasonable price for what I’m after. I was hoping to grab one of the smaller sized ones made specifically for pets to use, y’know? I don’t really have any other super strict preferences beyond that, as long as it’s nice and cozy to the touch.
